description: This PHP class 'Generator' is part of a documentation generation tool that converts structured data and content nodes into HTML documentation, including features like static asset copying, search indexing, and HTML content sanitization.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating HTML documentation from structured content data and nodes, supporting static asset copying, search indexing, HTML sanitization, and recursive page generation.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns available content types, specifically a Markdown content type configured with current settings.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Performs bulk generation of static documentation, copying assets, generating pages recursively, and optionally creating a search index.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Removes HTML tags and scripts from input text, collapses whitespace, adds line breaks around block elements, and ensures UTF-8 validity.

methods.name: generateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively traverses directory/tree nodes to generate individual pages or copy raw files, handling configuration rebasing and indexing.

methods.name: generateOne
methods.description: Generates a single content page based on a node, returning an object representing the page with associated content.
